All four published rows of Section 5 are now independently corroborated at the paper's published precision (0191 covered 1e9/1e10/1e11). (B) the NEW 1e12 point on the U3c residual ladder - the first measurement beyond the 1e11 memory ceiling of 0187 (the 20-window streaming interval sieve is the mechanism that crossed it; 56 GB peak/window, within standing rules). meas(1e12) = 0.539769 (se = 2.570e-6 over 37,607,912,017 gaps). Baseline: the R ladder's u3 = S2/(S2+S0) two-together pair model (twin-constant W(k) e^{-2k/L} sums, verbatim kcs3b machinery, K = 2000, e^{-2K/L} = e^{-145} negligible) reproduced against all 7 recorded ladder baselines (u3_tt = 0.555808/0.550315/0.548097/0.545905/0.542278/0.540762/0.539233; diffs <= 5.8e-7 - the baseline is the same object as 0173/0186/0187): u3(1e12) = 0.536638. THE OUT-OF-SAMPLE VERDICT (named discriminator, 0187/0190): (i) the 0186 4-pt mixed form R = -0.123764*delta + 0.715792*(ll/l)^2 (anchored pre-1e10 on 1e7..1e9; the sole survivor of 0186, under-predicting at 1e10/3e10/1e11 in 0187) predicts R(1e12) = +0.001883: diff +0.001248 = 485.6 se (measurement se alone) - DECISIVELY RULED OUT; its positive-excess streak (0187: +6.68e-04/+8.32e-04/+9.99e-04) extends to +0.001248 at 1e12. (ii) the 0190 DERIVED 2-term form R = -1.88114*(ll/l)^2 + 3.69471*delta*(ll/l) (the pure 7-point fit of the LOS-derived terms; terms a priori from the LOS q=4 expansion) predicts R(1e12) = +0.003139: diff -0.000008 = -3.1 se (measurement se alone; 0.26% relative in the residual itself) - CONFIRMED OUT-OF-SAMPLE at the ~3-se level. The two candidate predictions stood 0.001256 = 489 se apart at 1e12; the measurement fell at +0.003131, on the derived side. HONEST GATE STATEMENT (no drift): the program's strict-CI gate (a DERIVED, not fitted, correction landing INSIDE the measurement CI) is NOT declared closed by this entry: the -3.1 se is just outside a 2-se CI, the derived form's two coefficients were fitted in-sample on the 7-point ladder, and the nearest in-sample point (1e11) constrains the prediction strongly. What IS true: every previously live FITTED form of the residual is now ruled out at 15-486 se across 0186/0187/0192, and the derived 2-term form is the sole surviving candidate, confirmed out-of-sample at the 3.1-se level; the residual law R(X) = -1.88114*(loglog X/log X)^2 + 3.69471*delta(X)*(loglog X/log X) is hereby the RECORDING candidate for the U3 class residual over 1e7..1e12 (max |resid| 1.51 se in-sample, 3.1 se out-of-sample; the 3-point (loglog)^4.2 excess hint of 0188 is subsumed - it was the decay-cancellation appearance of this structure per 0190). No RH claim: exact integer counts (pi(1e12) identity), published-data cross-check, finite statistical model test; flank work; no gating of the mainstream.
